name: Mantys
long_description: Mantys builds AI agents that automate healthcare and insurance operations. We work with some of the largest healthcare groups in the Middle East, including Aster, NMC, Zulekha, Medcare, Thumbay and Fakeeh. Our agents automate patient access workflows such as insurance eligibility, registration and prior authorization by working across hospital information systems, payer portals and unstructured documents. Today, Mantys is deployed across 100+ healthcare facilities and processes workflows for more than 40,000 patients every day.
one_liner: AI agents for healthcare and insurance operations in GCC
